historical_problem: Category observations were liable to be mistaken for whole-question distributions

historical_problem: Multiple category atoms belonging to one question lacked a stable common parent grain

historical_problem: Category counts or joint counts could replace the actual question respondent base
historical_law_or_contract: n_respondents is exact question-distribution denominator; copy it; never sum it across categories/questions or substitute joint measures
persistent_authority_requirement: Exact value/source contract remains recoverable per component
derived_or_regenerable: Regenerable only if authoritative upstream denominator retained

historical_problem: Joint pattern count/effective-N/probability could be conflated with component question N

derived_or_regenerable: Derived metrics may be recomputable from frozen respondent substrate; authority carrier still needed
hostile_test_or_failure_mode: Reject substitution in either direction; reject summing component denominators to synthesize joint N

historical_problem: Raw numeric direction/intensity could be read as universal semantic meaning

hostile_test_or_failure_mode: Hostile case: source coordinate 0 on negative-to-positive axis is not semantic zero
notes: RETAINED SOURCE POLARITY is evidence, not canonical semantic polarity

historical_problem: V550/V551/V552 each reconstructed sign/magnitude, allowing divergent neutral/ordinal/missing semantics
historical_law_or_contract: Conservation target from Aug-15 hostile review: V551 is sole canonical signed-projection/adjudication boundary; V550 preserves raw identity; V552 consumes canonical V551 signed side/intensity and never re-infers scale semantics

persistent_authority_requirement: Projection inputs, authority hash and canonical output retained; no downstream re-derivation treated as authority

evidence_refs: Aug-15 issue register V550-002; master handoff V551 v5
notes: SEMANTIC POLARITY != RETAINED SOURCE POLARITY

historical_problem: Intentional selected-category partiality and unresolved repair debt could both be renormalized as if complete

persistent_authority_requirement: Coverage kind and unresolved mass must remain explicit
derived_or_regenerable: Summaries can regenerate from component ledger; typed state cannot be discarded

historical_problem: Joint evidence could be collapsed into first component or scalar row

derived_or_regenerable: Indexes/manifests regenerable if packet inputs fixed; governed packet membership/order persistent

historical_problem: Set flattening erases which item/component carried which role, target, denominator, scale, strata or absence

historical_problem: Family-level target semantics were lexically compared to direct structural targets

historical_problem: Direct target could be overwritten by family target
historical_law_or_contract: Preserve exact direct structural target independently; compare target layers only through governed compatibility semantics

historical_problem: Forbidden inference and absence metadata were vulnerable to being stripped as nonessential context

historical_problem: Downstream needed roles/targets/strata/horizon/constraints etc. that packet-level scalars could erase

historical_problem: Convenience scalar fields can silently claim packet uniformity
historical_law_or_contract: Scalar projection of any component field is lawful iff (1) complete matched component coverage AND (2) all matched components have the same non-empty value for that projected field. Otherwise scalar remains blank and component vector stays visible

hostile_test_or_failure_mode: Hostile matrix: complete+unanimous nonempty→allow; complete+mixed→blank; complete+any empty→blank; incomplete even if matched subset unanimous→blank
notes: COMPLETE MATCHED COMPONENT COVERAGE + UNANIMOUS NON-EMPTY VALUE
